text_block_list.text:
We're here for the Kinko Sho.

Matikanefukukitaru, our rival for today,
arrives at
the scene decked out
head-to-toe in lucky goods.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Михоно Бурбон, she refers
to herself
as "Full Armor Fukukitaru."
However, this is far
from being a joke.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
